name: plugin-guard
description: Security gate for Claude Code plugins. A mod judges every hooks module (JS/TS) before it loads, at start and on every reload or update: it scans the source and the capabilities the engine read off it, pins a content hash, and refuses risky or changed modules until you approve them. A SessionStart hook audits all installed plugins (shell hooks, MCP servers, scripts) and reports new or changed ones. Command: /plugin-guard

blockAt.title: Block at
blockAt.description: Lowest severity at which an unapproved hooks module is refused: critical, high, or off (report only).
